title: Adobe MAX 2011 - Photoshop Image Deblurring sneak
summary: A six-minute clip of Adobe's MAX 2011 sneak peek showing a Photoshop prototype that removes motion blur from photos. The audience reacts with astonishment as blurry images become legible.
why: Linked as a memorable early demo of image deblurring whenever threads on image restoration or synthesis come up.

quote.text: Audience: "No way!" and "That's impossible!" and "How did it do that?
